title: Timings
description: Measured segment timing, written to timings.json beside the narration audio. This document — never a hand-written number — is the single source of truth for scene durations. Shape mirrors max/server/explainer_mcp.py::_TYPES_TS and the writer at max/.explainers/scripts/narrate.py:290-297.

fps.description: Frame rate the frame numbers below are expressed in.

durationInFrames.description: Total composition length in frames, including lead-in and tail silence.

totalMs.description: Total narration track length in milliseconds.

audio.description: Filename of the narration track, relative to the video's public directory.

segments.description: One entry per narration segment, in narration order.

id.description: The id of the narration segment this was measured from.

startMs.description: Segment start on the narration track, in milliseconds.

endMs.description: Segment end on the narration track, in milliseconds.

from.description: Segment start as a frame number, for Remotion's Sequence.

durationInFrames.description: Segment length in frames. Never below 1.
